# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book is about treating artificial intelligence as an infrastructure:
a layer that other software depends on, that must stay up, stay correct,
stay affordable, and stay observable. It explains that infrastructure
design-first. For each piece, we ask how it got the shape it has, what
trade-offs that shape encodes, and what foundation it rests on.

A reader should finish a chapter able to answer "why is it built this
way?", not only "how do I run it?". That question is the spine of the book.
We reach it the same way through every topic: state the problem and its
constraints, give the design that answers it, trace how that design
evolved and what it superseded, name the trade-offs, and only then go to
implementation. The foundations follow the practice, in the same chapter,
because the theory is most legible once you have seen what it has to
explain.

## How this book is organized

The book is a stack, read bottom to top.

- **Part I, Systems.** Inference, training, and evaluation: the load
  bearing systems that turn a model into something dependable.
- **Part II, Applications.** Chat completion, assistants, and agentic
  agents: the layer where models become products.
- **Part III, Frontiers.** Autonomous agents and self-improvement: where
  the design questions are still open.

Each layer rests on the one below it. You can read a single chapter for its
topic, or read straight up the stack to see how a forward pass becomes a
conversation and a conversation becomes an agent.

## Who this is for

Engineers who build and operate AI systems, and researchers who want to see
how their theory lands in production. We assume comfort with one
programming language, basic probability and linear algebra, and the
ordinary tools of running software in production.

## Conventions

The authoring conventions are documented in
[`CONVENTIONS.md`](CONVENTIONS.md). Code and commands appear in monospace,
kept minimal and cited to source. Math is LaTeX and diagrams are Mermaid.
Each chapter opens with what you will be able to explain by the end and
closes with Further reading.

::: {.callout-note}
This book is a work in progress. Chapters carry outlines and open questions
marked as `TODO` while drafting proceeds.
:::
